title: Statistik per-run Lab jadi collapsible default tertutup / Lab per-run stats collapsible, default collapsed
summary: ID: 3 chart per-run LabStats (token/latensi/kecepatan) dibungkus details native default-collapsed; KPI dan tabel peringkat tetap tampil. / EN: The 3 LabStats per-run charts (tokens/latency/speed) are wrapped in native collapsed-by-default details; KPI and ranking tables stay visible.
problem_before: ID: Tiga chart per-run selalu terbuka membuat halaman /lab panjang dan berisik atas request user. / EN: The three per-run charts were always open, making the /lab page long and noisy, per user request.
solution: ID: Bungkus 3 blok chart (tokensPerRun, latencyPerRun, speedPerRun) dengan <details> native tanpa atribut open; summary memakai judul chart existing; tabel sr-only ikut di dalam. / EN: Wrapped the 3 chart blocks in native details without the open attribute; summary reuses existing chart titles; the sr-only table moves inside.
reason: ID: Halaman hasil lebih ringkas; pola details native sudah dipakai di LabCompareGrid dan LabHistory, DOM tetap ada saat closed (aman screen reader, test existing tak patah). / EN: Shorter results page; the native details pattern already exists in LabCompareGrid and LabHistory, DOM stays present when closed (screen-reader safe, existing tests unbroken).
user_impact: ID: Chart per-run tertutup default, klik judul untuk membuka; tanpa key i18n baru. / EN: Per-run charts collapsed by default, click a title to open; no new i18n keys.
tech_impact: ID: Perubahan komponen klien saja; pilihan buka/tutup tidak persisten antar reload (native details). / EN: Client-component change only; open/closed choice does not persist across reloads (native details).
